messages:
mia: Quick sync — Polaris (HW partner) requests a 2-day rapid-iterate bench next Tue/Wed. Goal: perf/W heatmap + kernel candidate validation. I uploaded a tracking sheet: https://drive.google.com/sheets/d/1-polx-example. Who owns harness, datasets, and success criteria?
jordan: @mia Polaris PM here. Confirmed — we can provide board images, on-board power sensors, and temps. Embargo until Wed after run. We need throughput (tokens/s), perf/W, and p99 latency for batch sizes 1 and 4 and seq lengths 128/512. Can Redwood run KV-warm vs KV-cold?
ken: I can provision a Dedicated pool for the run. Need kernel builds + quant variants pushed to the pool image. Which model are we running as baseline?
sam: runtime - we can do Cerulean-6B fp16 and int8/ggml-style quant. I'll set up warm/cold KV cache toggles and automated trace capture. Need the prompt set and a stable RNG seed. Also define exactly how we measure "perf/W" (board sensor vs external meter).
aisha: ops - I will schedule nodes but need OCI image tag and SSH keys + partner creds for IPMI. Also: do we want IPMI readings or external Yokogawa meter? Partner can do both if we ask.
mia: I'll own the runbook + chart templates for announcement-ready plots. Plan: dual measurement (partner sensor + external meter) for cross-validation. Acceptance criteria proposal: >=2.2 tokens/s/W at seq=512 batch=4 on Cerulean-6B fp16, and p99 <250ms at seq=128 batch=1. If kernel-var A improves tokens/s by >5% with <=0.5W delta, mark as candidate.
ken: Example run command I'll use on pool nodes: ```./run_bench --model cerulean-6b --build kernel-v12-opt --batch 4 --seq 512 --mode perf --power-sensor ipmi --output s3://redwood-bench/polaris/214200```
bench-bot: Automation: kickoff job 214200 launched by ken. Capturing telemetry to s3://redwood-bench/polaris/214200. Quick sample: 
[RUN] model=cerulean-6b build=kernel-v12-opt batch=4 seq=512 tokens/s=12.3 power=5.1W perf/W=2.41 p99=230ms
[LOG] KV-warm enabled, 95% cache hit after 5 steps
[WARN] temp-sensor A reading rising to 72C (within spec)
jordan: Can we align a short joint blog + datasheet? Polaris prefers embargo until Wed 18:00 CET. We should aim to lock benchmark artifacts by Tue EOD so legal + partner comms can review.
sam: Note: kernel-v12-opt consistently gives +3% tokens/s but +0.6W observed on our preliminary sims. We'll run both kernel-v12-opt and kernel-v12-base and include delta table. Also add single-thread run for fairness.
aisha: Scheduling: Dedicated pool reserved Tue 09:00 PDT - Wed 17:00 PDT. Please drop OCI tag and IPMI creds to #eng-infra or DM me by EOD Mon. I'll attach the runbook once pool is up.
mia: Cool — I'll draft the runbook (metrics, plots, embargo text) and share in this thread by EOD today. Please react with :thumbsup: when tasks are set. Thanks everyone!
